narrative.overview:
The implemented workshop places an editable illustration at the centre of a quiet, pale workspace. Serif project titles and the existing family icon identify the Hoard; compact sans-serif controls carry the daily editing work. This records the incumbent identity, rather than proposing a replacement visual world.

White panels sit on an ivory page, with sage selection states and muted green actions. The browser editor arranges tools, preview and object inspection around the work. Native command names and editable arguments use monospace where their literal content matters.
keyCharacteristics: Serif titles paired with compact sans-serif controls.
Ivory page, white panels and muted green actions.
Visible tool rail, preview and object inspector.
Existing family icon preserved as the identity asset.
Responsive reflow of controls and panels.

rules.name: The Green State Rule
rules.body: Use the existing green family to distinguish primary action, hover and selection; keep artwork colours independent of interface states.

rules.name: The Title and Control Rule
rules.body: Keep serif type for naming the work and sans-serif type for operating it; keep literal native content in monospace.

rules.name: The Visible Actions Rule
rules.body: At the small breakpoint, wrap the workspace actions so desktop opening, project download, undo, redo, format selection and export remain visible. The supplied 375px capture shows them in two rows; the exact wrapping follows available width and translated text.

rules.name: The Surface Separation Rule
rules.body: Use borders for panels at rest, the shared hover shadow for project cards, and the existing artboard/modal depth treatments in their own contexts.

rules.name: The Role Corner Rule
rules.body: Preserve the existing radius by component role rather than assigning one corner size to every surface.

rules.name: The Shared Selection Rule
rules.body: Use the same sage/deep-green treatment for selected tools and selected object rows, while retaining the active-tab underline.

dos: **Do** preserve the existing family icon, serif titles and sans-serif controls.
**Do** use sage selection states consistently across tools and object rows.
**Do** keep workspace actions visible through wrapping at the small breakpoint.
**Do** keep native names, object details and arguments literal and readable in their existing contexts.
**Do** distinguish presentation zoom from document scale percentages.
donts: **Don't** replace the incumbent visual identity while extending the editor.
**Don't** hide desktop opening, project download, undo, redo, format selection or export to simplify mobile.
**Don't** turn existing glyph icons or tracked uppercase labels into a required pattern for new surfaces.
**Don't** infer measured contrast, complete accessibility or native feature parity from this record.
